ideas.label: Centralization
ideas.principle: Use the center to increase reach
ideas.summary: Centralized pieces influence both wings and can switch tasks quickly. In endgames, the king should usually join the center as soon as tactics permit.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Centralization
ideas.summary: Centralization is valuable when it supports a pawn break, attacks a weakness, or escorts a passer. Do not centralize mechanically if the destination can be driven away with tempo.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Centralization
ideas.principle: Centralize king and rook around the passer
ideas.summary: In a rook-and-pawn ending, place the king diagonally ahead of the passer when possible, support the pawn with the rook after it is attacked, and advance only when both pieces remain coordinated.
